General Mathematics Colloquium
The General Mathematics Colloquium is a biweekly colloquium on Wednesday afternoon, 16:00-16:45 hour. The colloquium forms an outstanding platform for the lecturers to disseminate new developments to the institute in ...
Visit to Anton de Kom University in Paramaribo, Suriname
From February 26th until March 1st Diletta, Nicos and Raf visited the Anton de Kom University in Suriname to assess possibilities for cooperation between our institute and the math department in Paramaribo. Below is ...
Jo Ellis-Monaghan is new director of KdVI
Jo Ellis-Monaghan has been appointed director of the Korteweg-de Vries Institute for a period of four years, effective 1 October 2024. She succeeds Eric Opdam, who was director of KdVI for over nine years.

Education
Bachelor Mathematics
In the Dutch-taught Bachelor Wiskunde you are challenged not to study numbers and formulas themselves, but the world behind them.
Master Mathematics
In the English-taught Master of Mathematics at the University of Amsterdam, you can specialize in a sub-area of mathematics that appeals to you, while also increasing your knowledge of the discipline as a whole.
Mathematics deficiency courses
